🚀 happy | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enables users to access and control AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex from any device (mobile, web, desktop) with enhanced security and convenience.
✨ Key Features: • Mobile and Web client for Claude Code and Codex • Realtime voice capabilities • End-to-end encryption • Seamless device switching (phone/desktop) • Push notifications
📖 Summary: Happy is a cross-platform client for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex, offering mobile and web access with end-to-end encryption. It allows users to interact with their AI from anywhere, seamlessly switching between devices.
